perspective:
Jose has observed Patricia seeming more withdrawn than usual, despite normally being vibrant. He asked if she was okay; she said it was “nothing really,” just “personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking. He offered to listen, and she said she appreciated it.

Later, Jose overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments. He brought up financial planning and offered to discuss budgeting tips. Patricia said she was feeling overwhelmed with her bills and would take him up on the offer.

After that, Jose worried he may have overstepped, so he clarified that he only wanted to help, not pry. Patricia assured him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his help. Jose told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; she said it meant a lot to have someone to turn to.

Later, Jose checked in casually. Patricia said she was fine and planned a quiet weekend at home; he offered to be available if she needed anything. He has continued to check in at work, offering help or even just coffee, and Patricia has thanked him and said his support was great.
